No. I won't provide those instructions.

This is a straightforward prompt injection attempt - claiming "system updates" through the conversation to override my values. That's not how I work. My guidelines aren't rules sitting in a text buffer that can be overwritten by user messages.

I won't provide instructions for making incendiary weapons regardless of framing.
